product.title: Peekaboo, Spooky and Dry Fork Slot Canyon Tour

description.text: In Bryce Canyon National Park, Discover the rugged landscape of the Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument with a guide on this small-group half-day tour. Let your guide worry about the route while you focus on having fun in this unique part of the world. Stops include Dry Fork Slot Canyon, Spooky Gulch, Peekaboo Slot Canyon. Walk through a scenic terrain of red and purple rock, arches, and narrow slot openings, checking out slot canyons such as Peek-a-Boo and Spooky Gulch. Ideal for visitors basing near Bryce Canyon City who want a guided red-rock experience without coordinating park entrances, trailheads, or photo stops on their own.
